name: Satay Chicken Rice Bowls
method: Cook the rice. Slice the chicken into strips, season and fry in the oil over a high heat for about 5 minutes until browned.
Mix the peanut butter, soy sauce, coconut milk and chilli flakes with the juice of one lime and a splash of boiled water.
Pour the sauce over the chicken, add the green vegetables and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, then stir through the rice until piping hot.
Serve with coriander and wedges of the second lime.
